title: dlt: implement user definable non verbose dissection
description:
Allow user configuration for non verbose dlt messages.
Dissects non-verbose dlt messages, based on the user configuration
according to informations described in AUTOSAR_TPS_LogAndTraceExtract.

I will take a look.
This will take a few days as Matthias is currently not available.
This seems to be set but not used. Since a subtvb with a length is passed along, I do not see a big benefit.
Typo:  Message -> Messages

Indentation inconsistent. First two lines 1 space shorter.

Other lines are all on col 57 with =

Typo: at at
Value uppercase?

Typo: at at
Value uppercase?
empty line missing? More below.

Why wrap in do while?
More below.
Are all these macros necessary? Regular methods might be much easier to handle during debugging!?
2 newlines?
Formatting inconsistent.
* left and not right like at the other lines?
How is the case handled, when num is not 0? Could this fail on profile change?

From here to end of UATs:
- inconsistent formatting
- Remove DLT from start of Names. The DLT config should not have DLT xxx entries.

A few typos:
- lengthfie -> length field
- dimentional -> dimensional

Inconsistent to rest of code:
- Ecu Id -> ECU ID
- Id -> ID

Name conflict: "Datatype IDs" is used more than once as column in array table.
Why is this combined? Isn't this overly complex? And does ndim select which of both this is? Why are they not next to each other for easier understanding?
Why not use one for both? Just have bitesize always 32bit and use a typedef to create the second type.
Some spaces could be added to have more consistent code

For this to work, you need to guarantee that the param_name is unique or at least never reused with a different type!

While this can be done in an external config generator, it might be much easier and less awkward to have an additional UAT field with the filter name (example: filterstring in packet-signal-pdu.c)

Also, prefix the filters per type to make it easier, e.g.,:
dlt.non_verbose.struct.%s
...
Started with the review...
I do not have an example file yet, I cannot fully validate all aspects.
